_comment: Hand-curated map of model name -> protein target, served as the 'target' field of
GET /api/v1/models. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader.
Each entry records how the identifier was derived so it can be audited. Models whose
target cannot be established from the repo are omitted rather than guessed: an absent
'target' field is correct, a wrong accession is not.
The TRalpha/TRbeta accessions are the only two not derivable from this repo; they were confirmed by Marvin Martens on 2026-11-16.

TRalpha.name: Thyroid hormone receptor alpha
TRalpha.source: Not derivable from this repo. P10827 is human THRA; corroborated by an earlier copy of this service (VU_Google_Colabs/tmp_flask_qsprpred) that named the same model P10827_RF_Model. Confirmed by Marvin Martens, 2026-11-16.

TRbeta.name: Thyroid hormone receptor beta
TRbeta.source: Not derivable from this repo. P10828 is human THRB; corroborated by an earlier copy of this service (VU_Google_Colabs/tmp_flask_qsprpred) that named the same model P10828_RF_Model. Confirmed by Marvin Martens, 2026-11-16.

4or2_final.name: Metabotropic glutamate receptor 1 (mGluR1)
4or2_final.source: Model pref_name is 'Metabotropic glutamate receptor 1 (mGluR1)'; the archived sibling Q13255_Allosteric_RF_Model has pref_name 'mGLU 1', giving Q13255 for mGluR1.

8t6j_b_final.name: Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (mGluR5)
8t6j_b_final.source: Model pref_name is 'Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (mGluR5)'; the archived siblings P41594_Allosteric/Orthosteric_RF_Model have pref_name 'mGLU 5', giving P41594 for mGluR5.

Q13224_RF_Model.name: Glutamate receptor ionotropic, NMDA 2B
Q13224_RF_Model.source: Accession is the model-name prefix; model pref_name is 'NMDA'.

P31644_RF_Model.name: GABA(A) receptor subunit alpha-5
P31644_RF_Model.source: Accession is the model-name prefix; model pref_name is 'GABA'.
